sec.title: Results
sec.p: Of the 100 participants in cohort Alpha, we excluded 10 with condition A and 5 with condition B. The exclusion categories were mutually exclusive and exhaustive, and all remaining participants were included. Finally, 80 participants in cohort Alpha were included.

Of the 100 participants in cohort Beta, we excluded 10 with condition A and 5 with condition B. The exclusion categories were mutually exclusive and exhaustive, and all remaining participants were included. Finally, 85 participants in cohort Beta were included.
Of the 100 participants in cohort Gamma, we excluded 10 with condition A and 5 with condition B. Finally, 80 participants in cohort Gamma were included.
